invariants.rationale: This method performs its operations only if 'element' has type 'imagelayer', otherwise it is a no-op.
The method would likely only execute meaningfully if these core arguments are non-null; otherwise, adding layers or accessing map properties would fail.
If the layer was an imagelayer, an image layer would have been added to the parentLayers, making getCount() nonzero assuming it was previously zero.
Required for safe field/method accesses throughout the method.
An imagelayer is only processed if image is present as a non-empty string.
